newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open mostly unchanged Friday, dealers said, following sharp losses made during the previous session.

Some analysts expect the funds to further liquidate long positions, and pegged support in most-active July at 10.25 cents a lb. Others said July could retrace losses to fill a gap on the charts left on Thursday, between the opening price of 10.86 cents and Wednesday's low of 10.92 cents.
Producer scale-up selling is expected to block gains, however.
Thursday, the most-active July contract ended down 0.26 cent to 10.70 cents, having ranged from 10.86 to 10.67 cents. The back months settled 0.22 to 0.07 cent weaker.

LIFFE white sugar futures drifted lower Friday, after trading higher amid early trade buying. At 0848 EDT/1348 GMT, August stood 0.80 weaker at $309.90, while the back months were $1.60 lower to $0.10 firmer.
((-- S Rostler New York Commodity Desk, 212-859-1640))
